scope: Independent Python scalar arithmetic experiment; not production PNG, GPU, color-profile or Godot acceptance. Round-half-up; sRGB piecewise transfer; alpha is linear. All valid premultiplied RGBA8 channel/alpha pairs enumerated.
limits: 16-bit result assumes precision retained until inverse transfer and premultiplication; current STRIP_16 decoder does not do that. This does not restore precision already lost when importing arbitrary sRGB8 into linear8 tiles.
